mechanism: Execution: the active process of traversing a {{solver_tree}} downwards. Accepts a {{solver_node}}, applies {{decompose}} to its task, and either generates child {{solver_node}}s or reports the node atomic.
gloss: Vertical traversal of the solution tree
postconditions: Either child {{solver_node}}s exist, or the node is marked atomic
failure_modes: Ungoverned descent: the depth bound lives in `DepthGovernor` and `MarginalValueRule`, so an ungoverned dive descends until the substrate stops it.
Fan-in re-expanded: the runtime graph is a DAG, so a shared node is expanded once per parent.
